verdict.rationale: Lindy is itself an AI agent/teammate, so serving its workflows as MCP tools to other agents is a different product role. The MCP page content describes only client-side use: Lindy is pointed at a hosted MCP server and builds actions from that server's tools. The automated probe labeling that page an "official MCP server" is contradicted by the page's own text, and no evidence shows Lindy exposing an MCP endpoint or serve mode for external agents.
